title: Toolstem SEC Filing Intelligence
description: SEC filing intelligence for AI agents — 5 tools: filings summary, insider signal, institutional signal, material events digest, and disclosure comparison.

tool.title: Tool (optional)
tool.description: Which tool to run. Leave blank to run the no-charge default demonstration (get_company_filings_summary for AAPL) — useful for first-time evaluators and directory health-check probes. For real usage, pick a tool and provide ticker_or_cik (or tickers_or_ciks for compare_disclosure_signals).

ticker_or_cik.title: Ticker or CIK
ticker_or_cik.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL) or CIK (e.g. 320193). Used by get_company_filings_summary, get_insider_signal, get_institutional_signal, and get_material_events_digest.

tickers_or_ciks.title: Tickers or CIKs to Compare
tickers_or_ciks.description: 2-5 company tickers or CIKs for compare_disclosure_signals (e.g. ["AAPL", "MSFT", "GOOGL"])

lookback_days.title: Lookback (days)
lookback_days.description: Days to look back for insider transactions (get_insider_signal) or material events (get_material_events_digest). Default 90 / 365 respectively.

quarters_back.title: Quarters Back
quarters_back.description: Quarters to look back for 13F holdings comparison (get_institutional_signal). Default 4.
